title: Create a storyboard reference with GPT Image 2 and use it as the visual…
content:
Create a storyboard reference with GPT Image 2 and use it as the visual base/reference input for your Seedance 2.0 video workflow  
Generate each scene separately in Seedance 2.0, then edit the individual clips together into one short sequence

es.content:
